first_command.deviation: First command did not satisfy two-CPU/wall cap; no retrospective compliance claimed.

later_commands: Second command taskset enforced affinity before Python; subsequent Python commands call sched_setaffinity to first two allowed CPUs, ulimit CPU120/address-space6GiB, timeout140s. Python -I -B used. One failed bs4 import; replaced by standard-library HTMLParser.
telemetry_limit: Only selected resource snapshots saved; no aggregate cgroup accounting or every-process sampled RSS log. Tool transcript records execution, exits, and wall times. Managed web search CPU/RSS cannot be locally measured.
access: No api.github.com calls. HTTP 403 spectral journal not retried. 404 HTML bodies not retried. No browser, auth, contact, publication or TLS bypass. MathDB live denial inherited; not retried. Palomar recent.json returned403, not retried.
protected: No crown-vnumber lane read, scan, hash, glob, poll or edit. History limited to allowlist exact paths.
restrictions: No children, Lean, mathematical enumeration/solver/numerical search, git or shared edits. Only literal corpus text processing and ordinary mathematics.
jobs: All returned execution sessions reaped; every executor pool joined. No outstanding tool jobs.
